title: Build something people belong to.
intro: Equity Uprise brings music, people and projects together. Give your work a home, contribute your skills, and follow what comes next.

cards.title: Builders
cards.body: Create your profile and an owned website using your existing M Account. Edit your words, images and links, then preview and publish. Custom hosting and domain connections are optional and depend on setup availability.

experiences.title: Build
experiences.body: Create your free profile and website with your own words, images and links.

experiences.title: Run
experiences.body: Edit and publish your page. Storefront and customer tools depend on availability.

experiences.title: Grow
experiences.body: Choose whether your site participates in World; explore supported campaigns.

cards.title: Contributors
cards.body: Explore available campaigns, read the brief, and submit your work for review. Eligibility, available funding and verified work determine what can be paid. Participation does not guarantee earnings.

experiences.title: Discover
experiences.body: Explore people, projects and available clipping campaigns.

experiences.title: Contribute
experiences.body: Read the brief, complete the work and submit evidence for review.

experiences.title: Earn
experiences.body: Follow verified review and reward status. Eligibility and available funding apply.

cards.title: Backers
cards.body: Get to know projects and follow their public updates. Rewards-based backing is planned; no project funding is collected here.

experiences.title: Discover
experiences.body: Get to know creators, organizations and their projects.

experiences.title: Back
experiences.body: Rewards-based project backing is planned and is not collecting funds.

experiences.title: Follow
experiences.body: Follow public updates now; dedicated backing updates are planned.
